title: The Signal Metric and the Outcome Metric
short_teaser: An outcome may take months to appear, while earlier behaviors can signal whether progress is likely.
story: An outcome may take months to appear, while earlier behaviors can signal whether progress is likely. Strong plans track both. A useful strategy watches what predicts the result, not only the final result. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A useful strategy watches what predicts the result, not only the final result. Strategy is choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change.
spark_application: Identify the decision underneath your current activity. Choose the smallest next move that would create useful information. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
